scenes.text: Did you know that Apple spent a massive $89.3 billion in 2025 just buying back its own stock and paying dividends?
This is FinTok — your daily dose of financial knowledge.

scenes.speaker: MIRIAM
scenes.text: During 2025, Apple repurchased $89.3 billion of its common stock and paid dividends and dividend equivalents of $15.4 billion, as detailed in their 2025 filing. This significant amount demonstrates the company’s financial health and its commitment to returning value to shareholders. They also raised their quarterly dividend from $0.25 to $0.26 per share.
